title: Exorcist boy became aerospace engineer and urinated excessively after exorcism

tellings.quote: the boy who was at the basis that he was his story was used for The Exorcist the first Exorcist movie uh who then turned out to be like an aerospace engineer

plain: The boy whose 1949 case became the basis for the first Exorcist film grew up to be an aerospace engineer, and he urinated excessively after his exorcism. A scholar of religion named Diana Pasulka tells Michels this, repeating what she was told by someone else. If true, it ties one of the most famous possession stories to a later career in flight and space.
